title: Addex Therapeutics Reports 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update

# Addex Therapeutics Reports 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update


**Webcast conference call to be held Monday November 30, 2026** ****


**Ad Hoc Announcement Pursuant to Art.** **53 LR**


**Geneva, Switzerland, November 25, 2026** **-**[Addex Therapeutics](https://www.addextherapeutics.com/en/) (SIX and Nasdaq: ADXN), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing a portfolio of novel small molecule allosteric modulators for neurological disorders, today reported its financial results for the three-month and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026, and provided a corporate update.


“During the quarter, we regained all GABAB positive allosteric modulator (PAM) assets discovered under our research collaboration with Indivior and now have full freedom to operate in this program. In addition to advancing our in house cough program, the return of all rights provides us with a range of strategic options for a clinical stage asset in substance use disorders as well as the possibility to explore other indications for one of the broadest GABAB PAM portfolios in the industry. In addition, our spin-out company, Neurosterix, continues to make excellent progress across its portfolio with lead program, NTX-253, an M4 PAM with potential in schizophrenia, successfully completing Phase 1 clinical development. Neurosterix subsequently raised $105.1 million (CHF 86.9 million) in a Series B financing round in early November and now has the funds to advance its portfolio including completing the NTX-253 Phase 2 in schizophrenia. We have retained an 8.5% equity interest in Neurosterix valued at $18.6m based on their post money valuation,” said Tim Dyer, CEO of Addex.


**Operating Highlights:**


- Regained rights to GABAB positive allosteric modulator portfolio from Indivior
- Continued advancing GABAB PAM chronic cough candidate through preclinical development
- Spin-out company, Neurosterix, completed Phase 1 clinical development of M4 PAM candidate, NTX-253, and raised $105.1 million (CHF 86.9 million) in Series B financing round
- Raised $2.8 million (CHF 2.2 million) through At The Market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C Wainwright & Co

**Financial Summary:**


Income, primarily related to the fair value of the services received from Neurosterix’s Group at zero cost, decreased by CHF 0.1 million in the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period ended September 30, 2025.


R&D expenses decreased by CHF 0.5 million in the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to decreased GABAB PAM outsourced R&D expenses and reduced patent maintenance costs.


G&A expenses increased by CHF 0.5 million in the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to higher staff costs.


The net loss increased by CHF 0.3 million in the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to increased G&A expenses and a greater net loss incurred by Neurosterix’s Group partially offset by reduced R&D expenses.


Basic and diluted loss per share decreased to CHF 0.04 per share for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026 compared to a basic and diluted loss per share of CHF 0.05 for the same period ended September 2025.


Cash and cash equivalents remained stable around CHF 2.2 million for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026 and 2025. During this period, the total net sale of treasury shares and ADS has been offset by operating costs.

**About Addex Therapeutics**


[Addex Therapeutics](http://www.addextherapeutics.com/) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing a portfolio of novel small molecule allosteric modulators for neurological disorders. Addex's lead drug candidate, dipraglurant (mGlu5 negative allosteric modulator or NAM), is under evaluation for future development in brain injury recovery, including post-stroke and traumatic brain injury recovery. Addex has selected a GABAB PAM drug candidate for development in substance use disorders and has successfully completed IND enabling studies. In addition, Addex is advancing a differentiated GABAB PAM compound for the treatment of chronic cough. Addex holds an 8.5% equity interest in a private spin out company, Neurosterix US Holdings LLC, which is advancing a portfolio of allosteric modulator programs, including M4 PAM for schizophrenia, psychosis and mood-related disorders and mGlu7 NAM for mood disorders. Addex has also invested in Stalicla, a private Swiss company pioneering a precision medicine approach for neurodevelopmental and neuropsychiatric disorders.


Addex shares are listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and American Depositary Shares representing its shares are listed on the NASDAQ Capital Market, and trade under the ticker symbol “ADXN” on each exchange. For more information, visit[www.addextherapeutics.com](http://www.addextherapeutics.com/) .
